name: Waaree Renewable Technologies Ltd
tagline: Fast-growing solar-EPC arm of the Waaree group (now adding BESS and T&D) with spectacular reported growth and 50%+ ROE - but the stock is in a multi-year de-rating from ~250x to sub-25x P/E as the market re-prices it as an EPC contractor, with margins compressing toward 15% and order replenishment lagging execution
business_overview: Waaree Renewable Technologies (formerly Sangam Advisors) is the Waaree group's renewable-EPC company: turnkey engineering, procurement and construction for solar power projects, plus operation & maintenance, a small independent-power-producer (IPP) portfolio, and newer battery-energy-storage (BESS) and transmission & distribution (T&D) EPC via acquisition.
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 9,170 Cr (down ~14% in 1 year; ~68% below its peak)
FY25 ~Rs 1,500 Cr; FY26 ~Rs 3,000 Cr; Q1 FY26 revenue +155% YoY, PAT +207% YoY; multi-year revenue CAGR ~280%
EBITDA margin guided down from ~19% to a 15% medium-term target
~Rs 5,300 Cr headline, but the solar-EPC portion has declined YoY (T&D-heavy)
D/E ~0.06; promoter ~74%; near-zero mutual-fund holding for 5-6 months
fundamentals_narrative: On the surface this is a hyper-growth story - FY25->FY26 revenue roughly doubled, Q1 FY26 revenue +155% / PAT +207%, ROE ~50%, near-zero debt. But the market is deliberately de-rating it from a ~250x P/E two years ago to sub-25x now, and forum analysis explains why: (1) it is fundamentally an EPC contractor, which deserves a 10-20x multiple, not a product multiple; (2) EBITDA margin is being guided down from ~19% toward 15%; (3) order replenishment is not keeping pace with execution - the solar-EPC order book has shrunk YoY (industry orders were front-loaded ahead of the ALMM-II deadline and there is a grid-evacuation bottleneck), and management has been evasive on new solar orders ('maybe next quarter'); (4) the CFO quit in Jan 2025 and the Data-Centre CEO in Jan 2026; (5) a Rs ~11.6 Cr GST amount denied as ITC was capitalised into an IPP asset rather than expensed - forum members concluded the IND AS 16 treatment is defensible but that it does flatter reported profit.
technical_read: Not independently pulled; stock down ~68% from its peak, 52-week band ~Rs 780-1,358, in a prolonged multiple contraction despite rising earnings.
sentiment_summary: 147-post thread, currently focused on the de-rating puzzle. Bulls (meekinvestor, Rudresh) are baffled that near-100% YoY growth with cash backing keeps getting sold; bears/realists (kanvgarg123, vikas_chandrawat, Umang_Adatia) explain it as a justified re-rating to EPC multiples plus margin compression plus order-book concerns. cdas3317 and Karan_Sanwal debated the GST-capitalisation accounting and landed on 'defensible under IND AS 16 but profit-flattering'. karanshah137 (elevated) has repeatedly said he is 'just tracking, never invested due to high P/E'. CARE upgraded the credit rating to 'A' (Mar 2025).
community_signal: karanshah137 (elevated) - explicitly not invested ('never invested due to high P/E', now watching as P/E fell below 25); a neutral-to-cautious stance, not a conviction call.
bse_notes: No SEBI or fraud action found. CFO resigned Jan 2025; Data-Centre CEO resigned Jan 2026. A ~Rs 11.6 Cr GST amount (denied as input tax credit after a GST-team visit) was capitalised into an IPP asset and shown partly as an exceptional item - forum members judged the IND AS 16 treatment defensible but noted it inflates reported profit. CARE upgraded the rating to 'A' / stable (Mar 2025). Near-zero mutual-fund ownership for an extended period.
bull_case: Explosive reported growth (FY26 revenue ~2x FY25, Q1 FY26 revenue +155% / PAT +207%) with a cash-backed, near-debt-free balance sheet
Very high returns (ROE ~50%, ROCE ~63%) from an asset-light EPC model funded on customer advances
Group-level BESS (3.5 -> 20 GWh) and electrolyser expansion plus T&D entry widen the addressable pipeline; headline order book ~Rs 5,300 Cr
Multiple has already compressed from ~250x to sub-25x, removing much of the valuation air
bear_case: The market is re-rating it to EPC-contractor multiples (10-20x) - the de-rating may not be finished
EBITDA margin being guided down from ~19% to 15%; T&D mix is lower-margin
Order replenishment lags execution - solar-EPC order book down YoY, management evasive on new solar orders, industry orders front-loaded before ALMM-II and constrained by grid-evacuation bottlenecks
CFO (2025) and Data-Centre CEO (2026) departures; near-zero MF holding signals institutional skepticism about the whole renewable-EPC cohort
GST-capitalisation accounting, while defensible, flatters reported profit; working capital (inventory, receivables) has ballooned with revenue
thesis_fit: neither - an EPC contractor being correctly re-priced to EPC multiples, with margin compression and an order-book that is not keeping pace with execution; no credible path to a 10x from a ~Rs 9,000 Cr base on a 15% EBITDA EPC business
verdict_headline: Spectacular growth optics wrapped in a justified multi-year de-rating - EPC multiples, shrinking margins and lagging order intake. thesis_fit neither, conviction Low-Medium
verdict_reasoning: First-time coverage in this project (legacy project excluded it as too large; under the no-ceiling thesis it is 'neither' on catalyst/margin grounds). Reported growth is real, but the market's de-rating from ~250x to sub-25x reflects a correct re-classification as an EPC contractor.

Concrete offsets: EBITDA guided down ~19% -> 15%, solar-EPC order book shrinking YoY with management evasive on new orders, senior finance/leadership departures, and a profit-flattering (if defensible) GST-capitalisation.
karanshah137 (elevated) is on record as never invested due to valuation; no positive trusted signal, no conviction floor.
No red-flag tier. thesis_fit neither; conviction Low-Medium. Not flagged for 30-day revisit (thesis_fit neither); recheck if solar-EPC order intake re-accelerates and margins stabilise at/above 15%.

four_box.note: BESS/electrolyser/T&D expansion widens the pipeline but is undermined by a shrinking solar-EPC order book and management evasiveness on new orders — tailwind weak; order replenishment lagging execution — tam no; fundamentally an EPC contractor that 'deserves a 10-20x multiple, not a product multiple' — moat no; multiple already compressed 250x->sub-25x but 'de-rating may not be finished' — valuation weak. CFO (2025) and Data-Centre CEO (2026) departures are separate governance flags.
